summary: Mr. Mosseri discusses the Halabi community custom of using a silver coin for the consecration of marriage rather than a ring. He explains the traditional formula used during the ceremony and how the practice of verifying the coin's value has changed over time.
questions: Why does the Halabi community use a coin instead of a ring for marriage?
What is the traditional formula said when giving the coin?
What does it mean for the coin to be shaveh peruta?
How has the English translation of the marriage formula changed over time?
